(noun). bánh răng

These are gears of a bike

depend

(verb). phụ thuộc vào, dựa dẫm vào

Since he is handicapped, he always has to depend on is mother in terms of moving

terrain

(noun). địa hình, địa vật

The bike can go on mountain terrains

shift

(verb). sang số

This thing will help the driver shift the car's gears

attach

(verb). đính kèm, gắn vô

I attached a note to the report
